_notes.name: The header at the top of the page.
_notes.plants: One entry per plant. id: short letters, digits, or hyphens, unique, never changed once set (the watering log is kept by it). name: what the card says. type: picks the drawing: fern, succulent, vine, palm, fiddle, cactus, herb, or orchid; common names such as monstera or pothos pick the nearest one; anything else gets a neutral leaf and the plant's initial. intervalDays: days between waterings, a whole number from 1. light: the light it sits in, in your own words. room: the room it lives in. Optional: wateredDaysAgo, how many days before the page is first opened it was last watered (0 when left out, a full ring); notes, a line shown in its sheet.
_notes.rooms: The room tabs, in order. A room a plant names that is missing here is added at the end.
_notes.theme: greenhouse (light), nightgarden (dark), or auto (greenhouse by day, nightgarden when the device is set to dark).
